properties.name: booking.simulated-payments
properties.description: PROVISIONAL until step 9 (guide 20, part 5). Exposes POST /api/dev/bookings/{id}/payment-authorized, which simulates the card authorization. Never true in production.

properties.name: booking.jobs.enabled
properties.description: Turns on the scheduled jobs that close expired holds and unanswered requests (guide 21). False switches them off, for example on a second instance of the application.
